title: Bora Employer Pipeline Application Answer
description: One actual candidate selection/value event for an ApplicationQuestion. EXPLORATORY_CAPTURE, INTENDED_ANSWER, and SUBMITTED_ANSWER are materially different states that must never be collapsed or mutated into one another: correcting an exploratory or intended value requires recording a new ApplicationAnswer event, never mutating the prior one.

application_answer_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this answer event.

application_question_id.description: ApplicationQuestion this answer event responds to.

answer_value.description: The selected/entered value for this event. Null only when a value was not actually captured.

answer_status.description: EXPLORATORY_CAPTURE: a placeholder selection made only to reveal subsequent screens; must never be treated as applicant history, submitted answer, evidence, or a reusable/truthful candidate assertion. INTENDED_ANSWER: a real draft answer not yet submitted; must not be treated as submitted history. SUBMITTED_ANSWER: historical applicant-submission state, subject to existing immutability protections.

recorded_at.description: Date this answer event was recorded.

notes.description: Optional clarifications or provenance notes. Null when no note is needed.
